component.name: MAKO Assistant
MAKO 助手
component.summary: Install or remove MAKO Renderer frame generation for Steam games
為 Steam 遊戲一鍵安裝或移除 MAKO Renderer 補幀

description.p: MAKO Assistant turns MAKO Renderer frame generation (Mako FG) on or off for your Steam games with one click, adjusts each game's MAKO settings, and shows which MAKO features are actually active while a game runs.
MAKO Renderer is not included: install it yourself and open MAKO UI once before use.
